summary_en: ¥36/share full-year dividend for FY7/26 (¥34 previously forecast, +¥2 hike). Prior-year commemorative dividend (¥2) reclassified as ordinary dividend. Progressive dividend policy through FY30.
title_en: Notice of revision to dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief: On 12 June 2026, the board of エコム (Ecom, TSE code 6225) resolved to increase the dividend forecast for FY7/26 (year ending 31 July 2026). The full-year dividend per share is revised upward by ¥2.00 from ¥34.00 (forecast at 4 September 2025) to ¥36.00. The increase reflects a reclassification of the prior year's 40th-anniversary commemorative dividend (¥2.00) into the ordinary dividend. The company maintains a basic policy of sustaining stable dividends while securing necessary retained earnings for future business development and balance-sheet strengthening. A progressive dividend policy is committed through FY30.
